svg.title: recombinant chromosomes
svg.desc: Diagram reconstructed from lect06c-meiosis.odp, slide 20; embedded original artwork and editable labels. Coordinates corroborated by the original PDF. Shared chromosome bodies preserve the two chiasmata, two distinct homologs, sister identity and the red-blue-red / blue-red-blue double-exchange products. Original source labels and arrows remain live.
